title: 宇宙高歌東方紅 (The Universe Sings "The East Is Red")
notes: 1970 PRC documentary, Mandarin: Dongfanghong-1. The long window is the satellite's own 20.009 MHz transmission of 東方紅 played back on air, over the satellite turning and a telemetry trace; also the launch klaxon at Jiuquan, the launch itself, an optical tracking mount, a Yagi array and the control room, and the satellite on the bench. Fetched from bilibili BV1mRG1zxEVg with a full browser header set; cut from a top-cropped copy (uploader corner bug removed).
